description: Search a live index of ~12M developers (GitHub-centric) by role, primary programming language, location, and recent activity — for recruiting, GTM/lead-gen, and developer-audience research. Each result is a matching GitHub username, display name, and profile URL; your search filters are echoed back on the response rather than repeated per result. Filters: role (e.g. "backend engineer", "ai/ml engineer" — spaces/punctuation are normalized to underscores), primary_language (e.g. "Python", "Rust"), location, active_within_days (only devs active in the last N days), sort_by ("last_active", "commit_quality", or "external_contribution_ratio"; default last_active). Paginate with limit + offset — each requested slot costs 1 credit. Requires your own Revternal API key (BYOK) — pass it as _apiKey. Example: revternal_search_developers({ primary_language: "Rust", active_within_days: 30, limit: 20, _apiKey: "..." }).

_apiKey.description: Your Revternal API key (sent as x-api-key), from https://revternal.com/signup. Required — Pipeworx has no platform key for this pack.

active_within_days.description: Only developers active within the last N days (>=1).

limit.description: Results per page, 1-100 (default 20). Each requested slot costs 1 credit.

role.description: Developer role filter, e.g. "backend engineer", "ai/ml engineer", "frontend engineer".

name: revternal_search_developers
title: Revternal Search Developers
